# Retium SDK

> Rust SDK and command-line tool for the Retium blockchain, a post-quantum chain (ML-DSA-44 signatures) with a public testnet at https://rpc.retium.org. AI agents should read AGENTS.md first. It explains every common task with exact commands.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an agent works with Retium, from setup to deploy, with error handling
- [README](README.md): install and getting started for people
- [retium-agent.json](retium-agent.json): the network's facts in one JSON file (endpoint, chain id, fees, limits)

## Docs

- [What Retium is](docs/01-what-is-retium.md): accounts, coins, finality, gas
- [Quickstart](docs/02-quickstart.md): account to deployed contract
- [RCP-1](docs/03-rcp-1.md): contract identity, metadata and weight
- [Writing contracts](docs/04-writing-contracts.md): the contract model and its rules
- [Transactions](docs/05-transactions.md): what is signed, nonces, gas, results
- [Verifying code](docs/06-verifying-code.md): proving a contract runs published source
- [Security](docs/07-security.md): keys and what the chain does and does not guarantee
- [Wire reference](docs/08-wire-reference.md): HTTP interface, signed byte layout and the contract interface, for other languages
- [Tokens](docs/09-tokens.md): what wallets expect from a fungible token
- [Connecting a wallet](docs/10-connecting-a-wallet.md): signing from a web page
- [Errors](docs/11-errors.md): messages and what to do
- [Building with an AI agent](docs/12-ai-agents.md): for the person running the agent, what to give it and what to expect

## Examples

- [hello_counter](examples/hello_counter): the reference contract, in Rust
- [hello_counter_as](examples/hello_counter_as), [hello_counter_c](examples/hello_counter_c), [hello_counter_zig](examples/hello_counter_zig), [hello_counter_go](examples/hello_counter_go), [hello_counter_wat](examples/hello_counter_wat): the same contract in AssemblyScript, C, Zig, Go and WebAssembly text
- [run-as-runtime.mjs](examples/run-as-runtime.mjs): runs any of them the way the chain does
